test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offers a scheme of either selling articles at successive discounts of 30% and 20% or one where a customer can “buy 2, get 1 free”. The positive difference in overall nominal percentage discounts offered in the two schemes is:
solution:
**Given:**

First offer = Successive discounts of 30% and 20%

Second offer = Buy 2, Get 1 free

**Calculation:**

Effective discounts of 30% and 20%

⇒ 30 + 20 - (30 × 20)/100

⇒ 50 - 6 = 44%

Discount on "buy 2, get 1 free"

⇒ free item / (total item) × 100

⇒ 1 /(2 + 1) × 100

⇒ 1/3 × 100 = 33(1)/(3) %

So, positive difference in discount percentage 

⇒ 44 - 33(1)/(3) = 10(2)/(3) %

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
